content: Godot 4.7 testing: GUT 9.7.1 (2026-07-10) is GDScript-only and 9.7.0 explicitly adapted to Godot 4.7's stricter return-value type checking; CLI is 'godot --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gdir=res://test -ginclude_subdirs -gexit -gjunit_xml_file=...' and returns 0/1. gdUnit4 6.2.3 (2026-11-01) supports 4.6/4.7 (6.1.0 added 4.6, 6.2.3 fixes a fresh-4.7-editor font error) and its CI runs on 4.8.dev7 - pick it only if mocks or scene-level input replay are needed. 'godot --test' is NOT for project tests: it runs the engine's own unit tests and requires an engine built with tests=yes. Useful CI flags: --headless, --import (warm the import cache before headless runs), --check-only with --script (parse-only gate), --quit-after.
